clue.text: To hit back, cut the vegetable

indicators.note: back tells us the word for hitting is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: to rap is to hit sharply
a snip is a cut made with scissors

explanation.surface: Someone retaliating by chopping up a vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: A pale root eaten cooked, related to the carrot, is a vegetable.

clue.text: Get a good man in support when all's not so rosy

indicators.note: in places the article and the saint inside the word for a support

parts.note: a pier is a pillar supporting a bridge
ST, short for saint, is a good man

explanation.surface: Advice to fetch a good man to help out when life looks gloomy.
explanation.definitionFit: Pastier means paler and more sickly in complexion, the opposite of rosy-cheeked.

clue.text: Put out yet again about a matter of contention

parts.note: RE is Latin-derived for concerning, about
an issue is a point under dispute

explanation.surface: Republishing something about a disputed subject.
explanation.definitionFit: To reissue something is to publish or release it once more.

clue.text: Made a record that's well-known

explanation.definitionFit: To note is to write down, so noted means recorded; noted also means famous, as in a noted author.

clue.text: Bore giving the odd part free accepting nothing

indicators.note: accepting means the shuffled letters take the zero into themselves
odd suggests the letters of part and free are put into a strange arrangement

parts.note: O, the round figure zero, means nothing

explanation.surface: Something tedious about making an unusual bit available at no charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bore' looks like a noun for a tedious person but is the verb to drill; the anagram gives PERFRATE, and the O goes in after its F.
explanation.definitionFit: To perforate is to make holes through something, as a drill does.

clue.text: The point is last month mail got mis-sorted

parts.note: December, abbreviated DEC, is the last month of the year

indicators.note: mail that got mis-sorted is jumbled, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A complaint that December's post was badly sorted.
explanation.definitionFit: The dot separating whole numbers from fractions is called the decimal point.

clue.text: The people having a large number returned several

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a large number

indicators.note: returned means the word for several comes back, read backwards

parts.note: some means several, an indefinite few

explanation.surface: Several members of the public coming back after a crowd turned out.
explanation.walkthrough: DEMOS is the Greek word for the common people, as in democracy.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek, the populace or citizen body was called the demos.

clue.text: Cold overbearing crowd

parts.note: C stands for cold on taps
read as over bearing: ON for over (on top of) and COURSE for a compass bearing

explanation.surface: A bossy, frosty mob.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overbearing' looks like one word meaning domineering, but split it into over (ON) and bearing (COURSE).
explanation.definitionFit: A concourse is a gathering of people, a throng.

clue.text: Doctor receiving new agent for electrical equipment

indicators.note: receiving means the doctor's letters take in the reworked agent

parts.note: MO, medical officer, is an army doctor

indicators.note: new signals that the word agent is given a fresh form

explanation.surface: A doctor admitting a fresh secret agent.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram of the agent gives AGNET; 'Doctor' looks like a verb meaning tamper with, but is a noun here.
explanation.definitionFit: A magneto is a small generator producing current, used for ignition in engines.

clue.text: Glare about the way this is represented as the greatest

indicators.note: about here means turned around and moved about, so the letters of glare are rearranged

parts.note: ST, short for street, is a way

explanation.surface: Bright light spread around a road so it looks the most impressive.
explanation.definitionFit: Largest means biggest, of the greatest size.

clue.text: He wrote with little hesitation but faster

parts.note: Jonathan Swift, author of Gulliver's Travels, is a writer
ER is the short sound made when hesitating

explanation.surface: An author who wrote without pausing, yet quicker still.
explanation.definitionFit: Swifter is the comparative of swift, meaning quicker.

clue.text: The person in control may be a German

indicators.note: may be suggests the letters could form something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: Speculation that the boss is from Germany.
explanation.definitionFit: A manager is the one in charge of a business or team.

clue.text: Keeping almost within debt is tricky

indicators.note: almost means the word for within loses its last letter

parts.note: inside means within
an IOU is a note of debt, and 's stands for is

explanation.surface: Staying nearly inside one's borrowing limit is difficult.
explanation.definitionFit: Insidious means sly and treacherous, harmful in a crafty way.

clue.text: Flower has a neat look

parts.note: neat is an old word for cattle, so a neat is an ox
to eye something is to look at it

explanation.surface: A bloom with a tidy appearance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'neat' is an archaic word for a bovine animal, not tidy.
explanation.definitionFit: The ox-eye daisy is a wild plant with white petals and a yellow centre.

clue.text: Tackle for river fish

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for river on maps
eels are long snake-like fish

explanation.surface: Fishing gear suited to freshwater species.
explanation.definitionFit: Anglers' reels are part of their fishing tackle.

clue.text: Bearing with a young tearaway revealed the dope

parts.note: S, south, is a compass bearing
an imp is a mischievous child
let on means disclosed a secret

explanation.surface: A naughty child's behaviour exposing a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: A dope is a slow-witted person, a fool.

clue.text: Wanting the biggest share in the end?

parts.note: to be after something is to want it
most is the largest portion

explanation.surface: Asking whether greed for the largest portion pays off eventually.
explanation.definitionFit: Aftermost means hindmost, positioned last, at the very rear.

clue.text: Note the call is for the exercising of restraint

parts.note: TE is a note of the sol-fa scale
to ring someone is to call them on the phone

explanation.surface: A memo saying the phone call urges self-control.
explanation.definitionFit: Tethering ties an animal with a rope, holding it back.

clue.text: Dealing with many dreadful men, but taking it lying down

parts.note: RE means concerning, dealing with
C is the Roman numeral for 100, many

indicators.note: dreadful suggests the letters of men and but are a mess, so rearranged

explanation.surface: Handling a lot of awful men while staying passive.
explanation.definitionFit: Recumbent means reclining, lying flat.

clue.text: A painter races to hit the gin!

parts.note: RA, Royal Academician, is a painter
TT, Tourist Trophy, is the motorcycle races on the Isle of Man
a rap is a knock or hit

explanation.surface: An artist dashing to the bar for gin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gin' here is a snare, not a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A gin is a trap for catching animals, and a rat-trap catches rodents.

clue.text: To follow road transport on take-off

indicators.note: follow places the little word to after the vehicle

parts.note: a car is a road vehicle
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Instructions to trail a vehicle as a plane departs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take-off' is a parody, not an aircraft leaving the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: A cartoon can be a satirical drawing that mimics or caricatures its subject.

clue.text: Dined soundly at a reasonable hour

indicators.note: soundly signals that the word is said aloud and spelt differently

parts.note: to dine is to eat, so dined is ate

explanation.surface: Having supper at a sensible time.
explanation.definitionFit: Eight o'clock is a sensible time for dinner or rising.

clue.text: Refuse to dress before time

indicators.note: before places the clothing word ahead of the period word

parts.note: garb is clothing
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: Declining to get dressed ahead of time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Refuse' reads as the verb to decline but is the noun meaning rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Garbage is waste or rubbish thrown away.

clue.text: The examiners are upset over most of 23 dn

parts.note: read as set put up, which in a down clue writes the word set going upwards

indicators.note: most of means the final letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: the answer to 23 down, meaning curt

explanation.surface: Examiners in a state over a short answer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' is SET written upwards (up in a down answer), giving TES; 'over' places it above TERS.
explanation.definitionFit: Testers are those who check or test things, examiners.

clue.text: District producing some Bay City Rollers

indicators.note: some means only part of the words City Rollers are taken

explanation.surface: An area that produced the Scottish pop band Bay City Rollers.
explanation.walkthrough: The Bay City Rollers were a 1970s Scottish pop group.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tyrol is an Alpine region of Austria and Italy.

clue.text: Rates wildly about certain prizes

indicators.note: about means the shuffled letters go around the word for certain
wildly suggests the letters of rates are thrown about

parts.note: sure means certain

explanation.surface: Charges rising sharply around some awards.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram is TREAS, which splits around the inserted word; 'prizes' reads as a verb but is the noun for valued things.
explanation.definitionFit: Treasures are things valued highly, cherished possessions.

clue.text: Short extract from the charter seen in advance

indicators.note: extract from means some letters are taken out of the phrase the charter seen

explanation.surface: A brief excerpt from a document viewed beforehand.
explanation.definitionFit: Terse means brief and curt in speech.

clue.text: Nag the school-head reserved

parts.note: the head of school is its first letter
cold means distant, reserved in manner

explanation.surface: A headteacher who is aloof and keeps nagging.
explanation.definitionFit: To scold is to rebuke or nag someone.

clue.text: Register housing for duck or fowl

indicators.note: housing means the register holds the zero inside it

parts.note: a roster is a list or register
a duck is zero in cricket, written O

explanation.surface: A list of accommodation for poultry.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a duck is a score of zero, shown as O.
explanation.definitionFit: A rooster is a male domestic chicken, a farmyard bird.

clue.text: One so slow may well be cut off

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
late means behind time, slow

explanation.surface: Someone tardy risks being left alone.
explanation.definitionFit: To isolate something is to separate it from others.

clue.text: Jail, an establishment for atonement

parts.note: pen is short for penitentiary, a jail
CE, the Church of England, is the established church

explanation.surface: A prison as a place for making amends.
explanation.walkthrough: The Church of England is the 'Established Church' in England, abbreviated CE.
explanation.definitionFit: Penance is a self-imposed punishment showing repentance for wrongdoing.

clue.text: Revered figure having to trail back, lacking the right clothing

indicators.note: back means the word for trailing is read backwards

parts.note: to dog someone is to follow or trail them

indicators.note: lacking the right means the R for right is dropped

parts.note: a dress is a garment, clothing

explanation.surface: A venerated figure trailing behind without proper clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: A goddess is a female deity, worshipped and revered.
